title: BackFiller RabbitMQ Article-Work Response v1
description: Canonical application-level wire contract for BackFiller article retrieval responses carried in RabbitMQ RPC payloads.

requestId.description: Application request identity copied from request JSON payload.

messageId.description: Canonical NNTP Message-ID copied from request JSON payload.

backbone.description: Backbone identity copied from request JSON payload.

outcome.description: Terminal response outcome emitted to NNRPD.

uri.description: Success-only canonical article cache URI in the form cache://{CanonicalBackFillerFqdn}:{BindPort}/{MessageIdMd5}, where CanonicalBackFillerFqdn is a DNS hostname and MessageIdMd5 is the 32-character lowercase hexadecimal MD5 digest of the ASCII bytes of the exact messageId string.

error.description: Terminal failure detail for non-success terminal outcomes.
